messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGER: Elevated 5xxs and stalled streams across inference-api-prod. Top affected: /v1/chat (streaming frame drops) and /v1/embeddings (timeouts). 5m error rate ~14%. Paging @Priya S.

Priya S: I have the page. pulling up route metrics and last deploy. anyone seen recent config changes?

Daniel K: no deploys in last 40m. dashboards show a jump in simultaneous streaming connections and a surge in token rate for chat. embeddings job latency p99 went from 600ms -> 3.2s.

Omar: traces show many small streaming frames from one API key `noisy_tenant_101`. KV cache miss ratio spiked and worker slots saturated; queue length for pool-gpu-2 up to 1100.

CS Maya: three customers opened tickets about interrupted streams; one enterprise customer flagged a production job timeout.

Priya S: let's avoid cluster scaling first. prefer per-route/per-key mitigations. Can we quickly reduce chat concurrency and cap per-key bursts?

Omar: yes. I'll apply emergency edge rules:
```
redwoodctl quota update --route "/v1/chat" --rps 60 --concurrency 6 --burst 90 --reason "incident/2005000001"
edgectl throttle --route "/v1/embeddings" --rps 20 --burst 40 --reason "incident/2005000001"
redwoodctl key-cap set --api-key noisy_tenant_101 --max-connections 4 --max-tokens-per-min 15000 --reason "incident/2005000001"
```

OpsBot: Commands queued. Propagation to edge clusters (us, eu) in ~10s.

incident-bot: Note: temporary route /v1/rerank will be disabled if errors persist >2m.

Daniel K: propagation complete. watching.

Omar: after 30s: /v1/chat 5xxs down 14% -> 3.5%. p95 latency improved 900ms -> 210ms. embeddings timeouts dropped to ~2.2%.

CS Maya: sending stabilization notice to affected customers. escalating priority for the enterprise customer and offering to re-run their embeddings on dedicated capacity.

Priya S: good. can we also apply a soft-limit to streaming frame rate (to reduce tiny frames) and enable per-key sampling for top 20 keys for 20m to confirm noisy sources?

Omar: added commands:
```
edgectl set-feature --route "/v1/chat" --feature frame_rate_limit --value 10fps --reason "incident/2005000001"
observabilityctl sample-keys --top 20 --duration 20m --reason "incident/2005000001"
```

OpsBot: Feature toggle accepted. Sampling enabled.

Product Leo: tagging product for follow-up re: per-endpoint quotas and UX when a tenant is throttled. also flagging per-key burst defaults as a product decision.

Daniel K: logs show `noisy_tenant_101` made ~600 concurrent ephemeral streams with tiny payloads; likely an integration bug. recommending outreach and suggestion to move to Dedicated for high-throughput streaming.

CS Maya: outreach in progress. adding account note and sending suggested mitigations for their client.

Priya S: planning handoff to Daniel for RCA and follow-up. I'll stay reachable for 30m. summary: emergency per-route and per-key limits applied, system stabilizing.

Daniel K: taking over. immediate actions: collect heap/GC traces from pool-gpu-2 hosts, review client patterns for noisy_tenant_101, evaluate if we should auto-pin extremely noisy keys to best-effort pool.

Omar: prepared rollback commands:
```
redwoodctl quota reset --route "/v1/chat" --reason "rollback incident/2005000001"
edgectl throttle reset --route "/v1/embeddings" --reason "rollback incident/2005000001"
redwoodctl key-cap reset --api-key noisy_tenant_101 --reason "rollback incident/2005000001"
edgectl set-feature --route "/v1/chat" --feature frame_rate_limit --value 0 --reason "rollback incident/2005000001"
```

incident-bot: Incident ticket INC-2005000001 created. Reminder: update the incident ticket when actions complete.

Daniel K: 45m status: metrics stable, p95 latencies near baseline, per-key sampling confirms noisy_tenant_101 responsible for ~48% of stream churn. we've scheduled a postmortem and product/ops action items.

Product Leo: items suggested:
- stricter default per-key burst caps for streaming endpoints
- opt-in Dedicated routing for customers with high sustained token rates
- UX for customers when route-specific limits are applied (clear error codes + suggested next steps)
Logged ACTIONS: ACTION-2005000001-1, ACTION-2005000001-2, ACTION-2005000001-3.

CS Maya: enterprise customer rep confirmed stable after retrying their job on dedicated capacity. they requested a post-incident summary.

Priya S: closing paging loop. handing incident to Daniel for RCA and postmortem. thanks all. :thumbsup:

Daniel K: will post RCA and timeline in 24h. keeping incident open until RCA complete.
